## Deliverables & Line-Item Verification

All requested components in [scopes.go](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go) and [scopes_test.go](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes_test.go) have been inspected and verified against the work order specification:

1. **Declared Scopes Config**
   - [`ScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L53-L58): Contains `Topics`, `Externals`, and `Procedures` slices of `DeclaredScope`.
   - [`DeclaredScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L16-L24): Implements `Name`, `Kind`, `Keywords`, `ToolNames`, `Commands`, and `Description`, with flexible YAML unmarshaling for `tool_names`/`toolNames`.
   - [`LoadScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L60-L108): Loads `scopes:` section via `gopkg.in/yaml.v3`. Gracefully returns empty config on missing key or nonexistent file without error.

2. **Derived Module Scopes**
   - [`ModuleScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L110-L116): Implements `Name`, `Kind`, `PathGlobs`, and `Symbols`.
   - [`DeriveModuleScopes`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L240-L342): Strips filenames, rolls up directories with $\le 2$ files to nearest meaningful parent directory under `internal/`, `cmd/`, or root, transforms directory separators and underscores into kebab-case slugs, extracts anchor symbols, deduplicates, and sorts scopes.

3. **Alias Resolution**
   - [`AliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L344-L348): Maps old scope names to replacement scope names.
   - [`BuildAliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L473-L517): Iterates ops from `*ops.Reader`, collects `split` ops, and maps `DossierScope` to `new_dossiers`.
   - [`AliasMap.Resolve`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L418-L444): Follows alias chains to current scope with cycle prevention and depth capped at 10.

4. **Scope Resolver**
   - [`ScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L519-L524): Combines `ScopeConfig`, `[]ModuleScope`, and `*AliasMap`.
   - [`NewScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L526-L539): Constructor with nil safety.
   - [`ScopeResolver.ResolveScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L541-L718): Checks aliases first, matches anchors against module scopes via path prefix and symbol matching, and matches keywords against declared topics, externals, and procedures.
   - [`ScopeResolver.AllScopes`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L720-L765): Returns deduplicated, sorted list of all known scopes.
   - [`ScopeResolver.ScopeKind`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L767-L798): Maps resolved scope to `dossiers.DossierKind`.

5. **Tests**
